title: CARE: Causally-Aligned Reasoning Exploration for Medical Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.26147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for medical reasoning, yet the scarcity and cost of expert-annotated data constrain their progress. While reinforcement learning offers a scalable alternative, standard outcome-based methods in medicine often suffer from autoregressive credit assignment failure and gradient variance explosion. This leads to the "Right Answer, Wrong Reason" trap, where models inadvertently reinforce spurious correlations and dataset shortcuts rather than valid clinical deduction. translated_title: 因果对齐推理探索：面向医疗大语言模型的方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在医疗推理方面展现出巨大潜力，然而专家标注数据的稀缺性和高昂成本限制了其发展。虽然强化学习提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但医学中标准的基于结果的方法常常遭受自回归信用分配失败和梯度方差爆炸的问题。这导致了“答案正确、推理错误”的陷阱，即模型无意中强化了虚假相关性和数据集捷径，而非有效的临床推导。在本研究中，我们提出了因果对齐推理探索（CARE），这是一个基于理论的内在经验策展框架。CARE建立在高质量训练轨迹的两个严格条件之上：因果充分性，利用基于一致性的自验证机制来模拟$do$-演算干预，并有效去偏梯度；以及邻近可学习性，采用动态机制来确保训练稳定性。
tldr: CARE通过引入因果充分性和邻近可学习性两个条件，提出了一种因果对齐的推理探索框架，有效解决了医疗大语言模型中强化学习的信用分配失败和梯度爆炸问题，避免了“答案正确、推理错误”的陷阱。
en_tdlr: CARE introduces a causally-aligned reasoning exploration framework with causal sufficiency and proximal learnability conditions, effectively addressing credit assignment failure and gradient explosion in medical LLM reinforcement learning while avoiding the "Right Answer, Wrong Reason" trap.
